channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: 97 pc of TN ration card holders receive Pongal gifts
item.description: The Tamil Nadu government has successfully delivered the Pongal gift to a vast majority of eligible households this year, with official data showing that 2.15 crore rice ration cardholders -- about 97 per cent of the total 2.22 crore eligible families -- have already received the benefit.

item.title: 30 Amrit Bharat Express trains operational, 9 new services added
item.description: Thirty Amrit Bharat Express trains have been operational since December 2023, with nine new services added -- expanding nationwide coverage, according to the government.

item.title: Trump calls for end to Khamenei’s rule amid Iran protests
item.description: US President Donald Trump has called for an end to Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s decades-long rule, saying the country needs new leadership as it faces sustained public unrest.

item.title: Khamenei Claims Iran ‘Defeated US and Israel Again,’ Vows Punishment for Unrest
item.description: Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei said that the country had defeated the United States and Israel "once again" and had "extinguished the sedition" he described as being incited by Washington and Tel Aviv.

item.title: ‘PM Modi Means Development’: Assam Residents Welcome Kaziranga Corridor Project
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will perform the foundation laying ceremony for the Kaziranga Elevated Corridor Project, an ambitious infrastructure initiative worth over Rs 6,950 crore, in Assam's Kaliabor on Sunday.

item.title: Wanted Lawrence Bishnoi gang shooter arrested in Delhi
item.description: A wanted shooter associated with the Lawrence Bishnoi Gang has been arrested in New Delhi in connection with several cases involving extortion, armed attacks and illegal supply of weapons in Rajasthan, officials said on Sunday.

item.title: US Confirms Third Retaliatory Strike in Syria Over Killing of Three Americans
item.description: The United States military has carried out a third strike in Syria in response to a deadly ambush that killed three Americans last month, with US Central Command confirming the death of an Al-Qaeda-affiliated leader linked to the attack.

item.title: Bengal SIR: ECI sets target of seven lakh hearings per day to complete process by Feb 7
item.description: With less than a month left for both completion of the hearings on claims and objections to the draft voters' list in West Bengal as well as the publication of the final voters' list, the Election Commission of India (ECI), has now set a target to complete 7,00,000 hearings a day through 6,500 hearing centres scattered all over the state.

item.title: A R Rahman Breaks Silence on ‘Communal Bias’ Remark Amid Backlashes
item.description: Music maestro A R Rahman has been facing a lot of backlash for his remark on 'communal' bias in the Hindi film industry.

item.title: Eight FIRs filed in Varanasi over AI images, misleading claims on Manikarnika Ghat
item.description: Eight FIRs have been registered in Uttar Pradesh's Varanasi after alleged AI-generated images and misleading claims related to the redevelopment work at Manikarnika Ghat surfaced on social media, police officials said.
